description_en: Queries the details of a specified rule
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定规则的详细信息
name: GetRule

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the rule to query. You can view the rule ID on the Message Forwarding > Data Forwarding page of the corresponding instance in the IoT Platform console, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69486.html to obtain the rule ID from the response
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的规则ID。可在物联网平台控制台对应实例下，消息转发>云产品流转页查看规则ID，或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69486.html从返回结果中查看
parameters.name: rule_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

RuleInfo.description_en: The details of the rule returned if the call was successful. For more information, see the following RuleInfo parameters
RuleInfo.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的规则详细信息。详情参见以下RuleInfo

CreateUserId.description_en: The ID of the user who created the rule

Created.description_en: The CST time when the rule was created

DataType.description_en: The data type of the rule. Valid values: JSON or BINARY
DataType.description_zh: 该规则的数据类型，取值：JSON或BINARY

Modified.description_en: The CST time when the rule was last modified
Modified.description_zh: 该规则最近一次被修改时的CST时间

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the rule applies

Select.description_en: The Select content in the SQL statement of the rule

ShortTopic.description_en:
The specific Topic of the message source processed by the rule (excluding the ProductKey category), in the format: `${deviceName}/topicShortName`. ${deviceName} is the name of the specific device, and topicShortName is the remaining part of the Topic.
If the Topic contains the wildcard `+` or `#`, see [Topic wildcards]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73731.html）
ShortTopic.description_zh:
该规则所处理消息来源的具体Topic（不包含ProductKey类目），格式为：`${deviceName}/topicShortName`。其中，${deviceName}是具体设备的名称，topicShortName是Topic余下部分。
若Topic包含通配符`+`或`#`，请参见[Topic通配符说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73731.html）

Status.description_en:
The running status of the rule. Valid values:

RUNNING: running
STOP: stopped
Status.description_zh:
该规则的运行状态。取值：

RUNNING：运行中
STOP：停止

Topic.description_en:
The full Topic of the message source processed by the rule, in the format: `${productKey}/${deviceName}/topicShortName`.
If the Topic contains the wildcard `+` or `#`, see [Topic wildcards]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73731.html）
Topic.description_zh:
该规则所处理消息来源的完整Topic，格式为：`${productKey}/${deviceName}/topicShortName`。
若Topic包含通配符`+`或`#`，请参见[Topic通配符说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/73731.html）

TopicType.description_en:
If you have configured the SQL statement for the rule, the following values are returned:

0: a basic communication Topic or a Thing Specification Language model communication Topic.
1: a custom topic.
2: a device status Topic.

If no SQL statement is configured for the rule, -1 is returned
TopicType.description_zh:
若您设置了规则SQL语句，则返回：

0：表示基础通信Topic或物模型通信Topic。
1：表示自定义Topic。
2：表示设备状态Topic。

若未设置过规则SQL语句，则返回-1

UtcCreated.description_en: The UTC time when the rule was created

UtcModified.description_en: The UTC time when the rule was last updated
UtcModified.description_zh: 规则最近一次更新时的UTC时间

Where.description_en: The Where condition in the SQL statement of the rule
Where.description_zh: 该规则SQL语句中的Where查询条件

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
